task_completion.description: Navigate to the User Profile edit page in SuiteCRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the SuiteCRM 'Edit View' for the user profile (usually under 'Employees' or 'User Management').

task_completion.description: Update Title, Department, and Office Phone fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The fields 'Title' shows 'Customer Service Representative', 'Department' shows 'Global Support', and 'Office Phone' shows '(555) 019-9283' in the form.

task_completion.description: Set Date Format to Y-m-d and Time Format to 24-hour (H:i).
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 'Advanced' or 'Layout' tab, the Date Format dropdown shows '2010-12-23' and the Time Format dropdown shows '23:00'.

task_completion.description: Create a signature named 'Support Standard' with the required text and image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An email signature editor shows the name 'Support Standard', the text 'Customer Service Representative' and 'Global Support', and an image placeholder or the logo from /home/ga/Documents/support_logo.png.

task_completion.description: Save all changes to the user profile.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks the 'Save' button, and a 'Success' message or the updated 'Detail View' of the profile is displayed.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface rather than direct database manipulation or CLI scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on CRM buttons, and typing into web forms rather than just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The agent actually interacted with the file picker or image insertion tool for the signature.
integrity.visual_evidence: A file dialog or the image properties window in the signature editor is visible during the process.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the menu system to reach the profile settings.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking the user icon/name and selecting 'Profile' or 'Settings' from the navigation bar.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The user profile must be updated with Title: 'Customer Service Representative', Department: 'Global Support', and Phone: '(555) 019-9283'. The Date Format must be 'Y-m-d' (2010-12-23) and Time Format 'H:i' (23:00). The signature name must be 'Support Standard' and must contain the specified text and the image from /home/ga/Documents/support_logo.png.
